title: One reader of a criterion or test label in text
objective: A criterion or test label in free text is read by one function in `intentsvcs::id`, so no test or tool keeps a label grammar of its own.
body:
## Rows

B1, and Report E's D9 and T7 (triage P13, the home half). U3 put the one reader in `intent-cli/tests/common`, where the unit test in `intent-cli/src/mcp.rs` cannot reach it.

## Deliverables

- `intentsvcs::id::label_at(text: &[u8], i: usize) -> Option<usize>`, moved whole from `intent-cli/tests/common/mod.rs:1465`, with its doc comment and its rule that the zero family (`AC-0.0`, `AT-00.0`) is a format example.
- `common::label_at` is removed. Its two callers, `register_text_carries_no_maintainer_notes.rs:129` and `no_pm_state_in_output.rs:171`, call `intentsvcs::id::label_at`.

## Approach

Move the function as it is. It already reads a label's kind through `id::label_kind`. Change no behaviour. The two caller edits are one line each and go in the same bank, so the tree compiles at each commit.

## Dependencies

None. The intent-cli package (ic, ST1c2db93/efe0) depends on this one.

## Risks

A change to the text during the move changes what three scanners find. Move it as it is, and keep the byte-and-index signature, because each caller scans bytes.

## Verification

Before the bank, the builder runs clippy and critic-rust on its diff. No new test.

The batch decides this package: one `bin/devbin gate all` and one `bin/devbin test shell` at main's HEAD, after the last bank lands, booked by vc with the Desk. No gate and no suite runs for this bank alone.

## Seat and size

cc (intentsvcs). XS.
